dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Gnash The Legend arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to be fearful. Noted to snap at the leash and retreat to the back of the kennel when handlers attempt to handle him. During intake, Gnash was observed to growl while in the crate and escalate to thrashing while on leash. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Gnash The Legend
